capability_delta.sequence_21_sql_normalization: Trimmed and normalized unquoted ASCII whitespace plus one optional trailing semicolon, while preserving exact bytes inside single-quoted literals.

integer_catalog.behavior: bounded signed-i32/NULL insertion, declared atomic INSERT SELECT copies, and direct or SELECT-star membership with three-valued SQL semantics

text_catalog.behavior: bounded TEXT/NULL insertion, declared atomic INSERT SELECT copies, unique/nonunique constraints, and direct or SELECT-star membership with three-valued SQL semantics

capability_delta.persistence: deterministic atomic snapshot coverage expanded to all twelve table identities with structural, NULL-flag, capacity, uniqueness, and primary-key validation before mutation
capability_delta.pinned_suite_delta: from the first 58 queries through line 355 to every SQLite-enabled statement and query in the complete pinned in1.test file through line 1155

pinned_sqllogictest_file.claim_boundary: The complete pinned in1.test file passes for its SQLite-enabled cases. This does not claim the complete SQLLogicTest corpus.

text_catalog_sqlite_differential.test_controller_correction: A first deterministic generator was rejected after coverage counters exposed low-bit correlations; the accepted campaign used a deterministic xorshift stream.

snapshot_campaign.semantic_coverage: invalid schema/count metadata, all fixed TEXT lengths, all fixed NULL flags, active NULL with nonzero length, and duplicate non-NULL values in each unique TEXT table

snapshot_compatibility.boundary: Sequence-18 and earlier snapshots are intentionally not readable by sequence 19; hosts must retain the matching older artifact.

known_limits: Only the twelve declared one-column table identities and exact schema families are supported.
Stored TEXT values are limited to 32 unescaped UTF-8 bytes; embedded quote escapes are unsupported.
Catalog projection, general update/delete, arbitrary INSERT SELECT, joins, grouping, ordering, indexes, transactions, filesystem durability, and concurrency are unsupported.
SQL keyword casing and whitespace are not consistently general outside the tested grammar.
Validation and execution evidence is concentrated in V8 rather than multiple independent Wasm engines.
Most transient campaign drivers are not preserved; exact counts and hashes are attestations except where a materialized corpus or declarative contract is retained.
The source-free process is a documented policy and repository practice, not a remotely provable property.

promotion.source_free_policy: Only raw Wasm bytes, binary metadata, runtime behavior, external test logic/data, and opaque raw fragments were used; no JokeBase implementation source, WAT, compiler input, implementation generator program, or decompiled representation was created or inspected.
